title: EscortDef
description: An allied unit bought with scrap mid battle. It fights and it blocks: enemies in its lane stop at it instead of walking on to the hull.

weaponId.description: a weapon id from weapons.json; escorts reuse the same guns

damageScale.description: escorts hit softer than the mecha mounting the same gun

standoffX.description: px ahead of the mecha where it takes up position

cost.description: scrap for the first one this run

costGrowth.description: cost multiplier per additional one bought this run
